messages:
toni_billing: Heads-up: big customer Orion Labs attempted ACH setup via micro-deposits for payment of INV-2409 ($28,400) but micro-deposit verify failed. Customer reports they entered the two amounts we told them, but Plaid returned 'amounts_mismatch'. Need quick recovery options; invoice due in 48h. @maria_finance @csm_leo

ash_ops: Do we have the bank response? Could be rounding or bank delaying posting. Pls paste the verification payload.

toni_billing: Plaid webhook: ```items/verify_micro_deposits: status=failed; error=amounts_mismatch; deposited_amounts=[12, 34]; expected=[0.12,0.34]``` Customer says their accounting platform shows $0.12 and $0.34 — weird.

plaid-bot: Note: amounts are represented in cents in some payloads. Our connector normalizes to dollars but if connector mapping changed we could have inverted units. Suggest re-run verify or use instant account verification (IAV) flow.

maria_finance: Given the invoice size ($28.4k) we usually require micro-deposit verification OR Plaid IAV + consent. For faster recovery we can: (A) re-run micro-deposit verify now, (B) send IAV link to customer to instantly verify account, or (C) accept manual ACH push from the bank with bank letter + signed email consent (requires treasury approval). Which does the customer prefer?

csm_leo: I asked AP — they can do IAV right away but they need the link and are hesitant to re-run micro-deposits. They prefer IAV.

toni_billing: Sending IAV link now and pausing collection actions for 48h. Draft email: "Hi — we couldn't confirm your micro-deposits. For fastest processing please complete instant account verification here: <IAV link>. If you can't, reply and we'll provide wire instructions."

payments-bot: IAV link generated: https://pay.redwood/iav/verify/INV-2409-abc (expires 24h). Paused dunning for 48h. Logged on /payments/INV-2409.

ash_ops: Also filing BL-4970 to add a dashboard alert when Plaid returns inconsistent units so billing shows 'payload units mismatch' instead of generic fail.

maria_finance: If IAV fails or customer won't use it, we can accept a manual ACH on a one-time basis with treasury sign-off. Given amount > $25k, route approval to treasury lead @ash_ops. We'll need a bank letter + signed email consent including ACH details and preferred settlement date.

csm_leo: Customer completed IAV within 15 minutes and verification succeeded. They scheduled same-day ACH debit for today. Thanks all.

payments-bot: Payment method verified via IAV and ACH debit scheduled for today. Invoice INV-2409 marked 'pending ACH debit'. Closing thread.
